How to play

Watch the four pads glow and sing, then tap them back in order — or press keys 1 to 4. Each round adds one note up to twelve rounds. A wrong pad costs a life; you get three. P or Esc pauses, H spends a hint (two per round), M mutes the tones.

Restart

Every run restarts at round one with three fresh lives, and your best score stays in this browser. Press Replay (or Enter) any time for a fresh tune.

Devlog

The fourth arcade ship is an audio-first memory game built on the Web Audio oscillator voice the earlier games introduced, now carrying the melody instead of accenting it. The rules live in a small state machine that only wakes on player input or a single playback timer, so the page rests silent while idle. Twelve rounds quicken the flash from 450ms toward a 280ms floor, three lives forgive slips, and two hints per round replay the next note. Best score rests in a guarded browser key. Lesson one: melody is memory with the lights on. Lesson two: silence between notes matters as much as the notes.
